title: SKILL.md frontmatter contract
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter of every skills/<id>/SKILL.md file. This is the build-time contract referenced by ARCHITECTURE_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md §3.2. Phase 0 introduces it in --warn mode: only `name` and `description` are required (the two fields every one of the 1,812 corpus skills already carries and the only two the router reads today). Every other field is OPTIONAL and backfilled incrementally; `additionalProperties` is true so unschema'd skills and existing keys (license, metadata, allowed-tools, …) keep validating unchanged. The validator flips from --warn to --error in a later phase once the corpus is backfilled. NOTHING here changes runtime routing behavior.

name.description: Canonical kebab-case skill id. MUST equal the skill's directory name (the router treats the directory name, not this field, as the authoritative id — they must agree). Invariant: kebab canonical ids.

version.description: NEW (Phase 0). Per-skill semantic version (semver 2.0.0). Absent today on all but a handful of skills; defaults conceptually to 0.0.0 / unversioned. Powers Phase 5 distribution (content-addressed, pullable packages).

description.description: Single-line skill description, whitespace-collapsed. This is the primary lexical-routing signal today and the text embedded for semantic routing in Phase 1. Block scalars (| or >) are folded to a single space by the registry parser.

aliases.description: Alternate kebab-case ids that resolve to this skill. Exact-alias match is a deterministic routing guardrail that wins outright (preserved invariant). Must not collide with any other skill's canonical name or alias.

domain.description: NEW (Phase 0). Single top-level taxonomy bucket for the skill. One value only (facets go in `tags`). Used as a reranker feature and for browse/grouping. The enum is the recommended controlled vocabulary; unknown values are reported as warnings (not hard errors) during incremental adoption.

tags.description: NEW (Phase 0). Free-form kebab-case facets (language, framework, capability area). Unlike `domain` a skill may carry many. Feeds lexical recall and faceted search.

triggers.description: NEW (Phase 0). Example end-user prompts that SHOULD route to this skill. These are free, skill-authored labeled routing data: the eval harness (tests/routing-eval) auto-seeds a positive case from every trigger. Write natural prompts a user would actually type, not keywords.
examples: write pytest fixtures for a fastapi app

capabilities.description: NEW (Phase 0). Typed, dotted capability verbs this skill provides (namespace.verb). Powers Phase 4 composition (capability-typed DAGs). Distinct from `requires` (which lists what the skill needs).

requires.description: Formalized dependency declaration (806 corpus skills already carry a nested `requires:` block). All three sub-keys are optional and default to empty. A skill with no external dependencies may omit this entirely or leave the lists empty.

mcp.description: MCP servers/tools this skill expects to be connected (e.g. Rube/Composio tool namespaces).

tools.description: Host tool names this skill expects (e.g. Bash, WebFetch).

env.description: Environment variables / secrets the skill needs at run time (names only — never values; public-safe invariant).

quality_tier.description: NEW (Phase 0). Lifecycle/trust tier. Reranker feature and a browse filter. Absent → treated as `experimental`.

supersedes.description: NEW (Phase 0). Kebab ids of skills this skill replaces (lifecycle edge). Used to steer routing away from superseded skills and to drive deprecation.

conflicts.description: NEW (Phase 0). Kebab ids of skills that must not be composed/loaded alongside this one (mutual-exclusion edge for Phase 4 composition).

kebabId.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier: ASCII letters/digits separated by single hyphens, no leading/trailing/double hyphens.

semver.description: Semantic Version 2.0.0 string (the official semver regex).

capability.description: Dotted lowercase capability verb, namespace.verb (at least two segments), e.g. code.generate, test.author, web.scrape.

domain.description: Recommended single-domain controlled vocabulary. Treated as a soft constraint during incremental backfill (unknown values warn rather than error).
